headline: Strong idempotency fix with fast, focused validation
rationale: Strong, rapid fix combining deduplication and monotonic state ordering. Tests pass quickly, but atomicity under concurrent deliveries is not demonstrated.
strengths: Adds delivery_id deduplication using the ledger
Enforces forward-only state transitions with STATUS_RANK
Clarifies edge-case semantics and validates with tests
weaknesses: Only four tests; concurrency and crash atomicity remain unproven
No evidence of persistence, retries, or ledger transaction boundaries
